stem: Using Lehr's rule, n per variant ≈ 16 × p(1 - p) / δ² (an approximation for 80% power and a two-sided 5% significance level), a test with a baseline conversion of 10% should detect a rise to 11%. How many users does the test need in total, across both variants of a 50/50 split? Use the baseline rate for p and give a whole number.
